title: The Alchemist's Sanctum
description: A woman in an ornate purple velvet gown stands at a wooden apothecary counter inside a mystical laboratory. The room is filled with glowing potion bottles, framed paintings of butterflies and animals, an eye-shaped skylight, and magical artifacts, viewed through a purple arched doorway with red tassels.
prompt: A woman wearing a long ornate purple velvet dress with white sleeves stands at a wooden counter inside a mystical alchemist laboratory. The room has purple walls covered in framed paintings of glowing blue butterflies, foxes, and plants. Shelves are filled with colorful glowing potion bottles. An eye-shaped stained glass skylight is in the ceiling. Red tassels hang from a large purple and gold archway framing the entire scene. Magical, detailed fantasy interior, rich colors, atmospheric lighting.
